stem:
Tanya is planning for healthy growth during adolescence.

Which plan is best?

options.text: Eat a varied nutritious diet with proteins, carbohydrates, fats, vitamins and minerals, and take part in regular exercise and games.
Replace all protein with carbohydrates, keep fats, vitamins and minerals, and keep regular exercise.
Eat a varied nutritious diet every day, but skip exercise and physical games.
Choose sweets and soft drinks rather than varied nutritious meals, and keep exercising.

teacher.key_rationale: Healthy adolescent growth needs a varied nutritious diet and regular physical activity. Carbohydrates cannot replace all protein; diet without exercise omits activity; sweets are not a nutritious base.
